text:
Priya: Quick post-huddle check-in 1 I want to capture the actions we agreed on and any clarifications for the GA timeline and observability asks. Short thread so folks can ACK.

Maya: thanks! Noting one question from legal on data residency for Private deployments 1 who owns follow-up?

Priya: Good catch. Owner: Marco + Legal. Marco can you confirm next steps?

Marco: Will sync with Legal and ProdOps tomorrow AM. Plan: short checklist of region-specific requirements and a proposed KMS pattern. ETA: Fri COB.

Sonia: Observable retention note 1 leadership asked about default retention length for enterprise. We proposed 90d but need infra cost table and migration path for customers on older defaults. Owner: Sonia + EngInfra. Due: Wed.

Ken: I'll take the migration path outline. Also adding a small test to validate retention TTL enforcement across deployments. PR target: next Tue.

Taylor: Docs/onboarding templates for Dedicated 1 I'll scaffold runbooks and a customer-facing checklist. Putting the draft in the docs repo under: https://github.com/redwood/docs/tree/dedicated-onboarding 

Priya: Autoscale and probe stability were flagged as blockers for GA. Owner: Ken to lead probe stability tests; Eng-SRE to own rollout gating.

Ken: Adding a short checklist in the infra repo. Will include: probe jitter tests, cold-start latency, and fallback routing validation.

Marco: Clarify: default fallback policy should prefer a compatible cheaper variant only if latency SLO remains satisfied and model quality delta < configured threshold. Ops teams, add this to routing policy docs.

Sonia: Question: do we want an automated rollback if quality regressions exceed threshold during canary? Leadership preferred manual review + auto-safeguard opt-in. I'll write a proposal. Owner: Sonia, due Mon.

Priya: Small prioritization note from leadership: make Dedicated GA onboarding and autoscale stability top priority; observability retention next; docs and UI wording tweaks are low effort and can be parallelized.

deploy-bot: [deploy] docs: dedicated-onboarding scaffold pushed by Taylor 1 preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/1289

Priya: Action summary 1 please ACK next to your name in thread if you own something:

- Marco + Legal: data residency checklist & KMS pattern 1 due Fri COB
- Sonia + EngInfra: retention cost & migration plan (90d default) 1 due Wed EOD
- Ken + Eng-SRE: probe stability tests + routing smoke tests 1 PR by Tue, smoke suite update in 2w
- Taylor: Dedicated onboarding runbooks + customer checklist 1 draft in docs repo, ping when ready
- Sonia: canary rollback vs auto-safeguard proposal 1 due Mon
- All: add any remaining open asks to the AH tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/ALLHANDS-TRACKER

Marco: ACK

Ken: ACK 1 will post the PR link in #eng-infra when ready.

Sonia: ACK 1 posting draft Wed AM for comments.

Taylor: ACK 1 will ping when runbook PR is up.

Maya: ACK 1 legal review scheduled for Thu.

Priya: Thanks everyone. I'll compile a one-pager and link it to the AH tracker tomorrow morning. If any timeline slippage, DM me. :sparkles:
